method: Seeded metamorphic expansion of independently observed supported parity corpus anchors; not arbitrary matcher fuzzing.
limits: No compatibility claim beyond the declared pinned subset.
Known strict boundaries, error-only models, comma-key collision values and NUL values are excluded from generated inputs and remain in the separately checked baseline corpora.
KeyMatch string values are unchanged by alpha renaming; guarded duplicates/permutations/priority offsets/numeric scaling may still vary those cases.
All 837 eligible anchors were covered across three seeds; this is anchor coverage, not source-line, branch, state-space or arbitrary-input coverage.
Full JSONL records were audited against deterministic source generation and reconstructed protocol inputs; audit does not reexecute the 9000 cases, whose recorded native runs are verified exactly.
